items.title_zh: 近 200 万条请求揭开 AI 隐私漏洞：“零数据保留”也会泄密
items.title_en: Nearly 2 Million Requests Expose AI Privacy Flaws: 'Zero Data Retention' Can Still Leak
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，科技媒体 Ars Technica 今天（11 月 21 日）发布博文，报道称安全公司 Dragos 首席研究官 HD Moore 向多家 AI 服务商发送近 200 万条带有可追踪“诱饵”的请求， 发现 AI 服务链存在黑客窃取提示词、转售商泄露数据及未遵守隐私设置等问题。 研究人员故意把一批可追踪的“测试秘密”（并非从真实用户渠道收集）发给 AI，观察之后有没有其他程序或人拿它们去访问系统，从而判断数据是否流出、可能从哪条服务链流出。 调查发现，至少三家服务商出现遭入侵迹象，攻击者利用窃取的诱饵密钥发起数万次云服务接口调用，尝试寻找更多凭证、开通服务并维持访问权限。部分密钥在提交后数小时内便被使用，甚至有请求在模型运行前已遭拒绝，其中的密钥仍被盗走。 风险还来自层层转手的服务链。许多 AI 应用通过中间商分配请求，内容可能经过多个平台，并在各环节解密处理。研究还发现，部分转售商记录并外传请求；一些标记“零数据保留”或“禁止数据收集”的请求，其私密网址仍在数日后遭到抓取。 Moore 建议，敏感业务可考虑本地部署；无法自建的用户应尽量直接选择可信服务商，并明确指定上游提供方。 IT之家附上参考地址 Three breaches, endless leaks: Your AI supply chain needs canaries
items.summary_en: Tech media Ars Technica published a post on November 21 reporting that HD Moore, chief research officer at security firm Dragos, sent nearly 2 million requests containing trackable "canaries" to multiple AI providers and found problems in the AI service chain including hackers stealing prompts, resellers leaking data, and privacy settings not being honored. The researchers deliberately sent a set of trackable "test secrets" (not collected from real user channels) to AI systems and then observed whether other programs or people used them to access systems, in order to determine whether data leaked and through which part of the service chain. The investigation found signs of compromise at at least three providers, with attackers using stolen canary keys to make tens of thousands of cloud service API calls, attempting to find more credentials, provision services and maintain access. Some keys were used within hours of submission; in some cases requests were rejected before the model ran, yet the keys were still stolen. Risk also comes from multi-layered resale chains: many AI apps distribute requests through intermediaries, so content may pass through multiple platforms and be decrypted at each stage. The research also found that some resellers logged and passed on requests, and that some requests marked "zero data retention" or "no data collection" had their private URLs crawled days later. Moore suggested sensitive businesses consider on-premise deployment; those unable to self-host should choose trusted providers directly and explicitly designate the upstream provider.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该研究属实，说明AI服务层层转售与中间商环节可能是数据外泄的薄弱点，“零数据保留”承诺或难以覆盖整条链路；但结论来自单一安全公司红队测试，尚待独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: if accurate, the research suggests reseller and intermediary layers in AI service chains may be weak points for data leakage, and "zero data retention" pledges may not cover the whole chain; but the findings come from a single security firm's red-team testing and await independent verification.

items.title_zh: 美参议员痛批苹果、谷歌：放任 AI 脱衣应用“野蛮生长”
items.title_en: US senators slam Apple and Google for letting AI 'nudify' apps run rampant
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据英国《卫报》报道，美国参议员罗恩 · 怀登、埃德 · 马基和本 · 卢汉指出，苹果和谷歌未能有效识别或下架用于生成未经当事人同意的裸照或色情图像的应用。 三人还指出，Meta 仍在从这些所谓的 AI 脱衣应用广告中获利。 当地时间 18 日，三人向苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的 CEO 致函，指出各公司现有的防护措施 不足以阻止 AI 脱衣应用出现在各自的应用商店或平台上 。 研究发现，苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的政策均禁止此类应用，它们却仍然出现在苹果和谷歌应用商店中，或通过 Meta 平台上的广告推广。研究还发现，儿童依然能够轻易接触到这些应用。 来自俄勒冈州的参议员怀登指出，如果这些公司不加强打击那些专门为造成伤害而设计并推广的应用，国会就需要采取行动。“AI 大幅提升了制作和传播未经当事人同意的色情影像的能力，给女性和女孩造成了巨大伤害。大型科技公司没有增加应对这一挑战的投入，反而在削减负责保护用户免受伤害的团队。我希望弄清楚，为什么 Meta、苹果和谷歌会漏掉那些明显违反自身规则的行为。” 谷歌发言人卡尔 · 瑞安在声明中回应称：“Google Play 不允许含有色情内容或允许用户对他人图像进行 AI 脱衣处理的应用上架。我们一直主动采取措施，检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。” Meta 发言人安迪 · 斯通在声明中回应称：“我们禁止传播儿童性虐待材料（CSAM），也禁止推广 AI 脱衣应用，并积极采取措施，防止此类内容出现在我们的平台上。…… 我们已经采取多项措施打击这些行为，包括封禁、对其他广告商采取法律行动、打击协同行动网络，以及 删除 9200 万条色情广告 。我们也在积极探索进一步改进检测能力的方法。” 苹果发言人彼得 · 阿杰米安表示，TTP 的报告并未反映苹果现行的软件及安全功能。苹果新增的保护措施包括加强对青少年的保护，以及在“屏幕使用时间”中扩展家长控制功能，让家庭能够阻止儿童和青少年下载年龄分级超出其年龄范围的应用。 IT之家从报道中获悉，参议员们在信中指出，过去两年， 未经当事人同意而由 AI 生成的裸照数量有所增加 。这一趋势也在多项调查得到印证。联合国儿童基金会在 2026 年初发布的报告显示，11 个国家至少有 120 万名儿童报告称，自己曾遭遇未经本人同意的裸照侵害。 10 月，TTP 研究人员就他们在苹果 App Store 发现的 AI 脱衣应用联系苹果后，苹果对自身政策作出了进一步说明。谷歌此前向《卫报》表示，公司会主动检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。Meta 则推出了新的 AI 工具，专门用于识别和删除含有 CSAM 的广告。 参议员们在信中写道，这些发现表明，苹果和谷歌不仅没有下架助长私密影像侵害的应用，还可能从这些应用的分发过程中获利。
items.summary_en: According to The Guardian, US Senators Ron Wyden, Ed Markey and Ben Luján said Apple and Google have failed to effectively identify or remove apps used to generate non-consensual nude or sexual images, and said Meta is still profiting from ads for so-called AI nudify apps. On the 18th local time, the three sent letters to the CEOs of Apple, Google and Meta, saying existing safeguards are insufficient to stop such apps from appearing on their app stores or platforms. The research found that all three companies' policies prohibit such apps, yet they still appear in the Apple and Google app stores or are promoted through ads on Meta's platforms, and that children can still easily access them. Wyden said that if the companies do not step up the fight against apps designed and promoted to cause harm, Congress will need to act, adding that "AI has vastly increased the ability to create and spread non-consensual sexual imagery, causing enormous harm to women and girls. Instead of increasing investment to meet this challenge, Big Tech companies are cutting teams responsible for protecting users from harm." Google spokesperson Karl Ryan said in a statement that Google Play does not allow apps that contain sexual content or let users 'nudify' images of others, and that the company proactively detects and removes apps with harmful content. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone said the company prohibits child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and the promotion of AI nudify apps, and said it has taken measures including bans, legal action against other advertisers, disrupting coordinated networks and removing 92 million sexual-content ads. Apple spokesperson Peter Ajemian said TTP's report does not reflect Apple's current software and safety features, and that Apple has added protections for minors and expanded parental controls in Screen Time. In the letters, the senators noted that non-consensual AI-generated nude images have increased over the past two years, and a UNICEF report published in early 2026 showed that at least 1.2 million children in 11 countries reported being victimized by non-consensual nude imagery. In October, after TTP researchers contacted Apple about AI nudify apps found in the App Store, Apple further clarified its policies; Google previously told The Guardian it proactively detects and removes apps with harmful content; Meta launched a new AI tool specifically to identify and remove ads containing CSAM. The senators wrote that these findings show Apple and Google not only failed to remove apps that facilitate intimate-image abuse but may also profit from distributing them.
items.why_zh: 推测：参议员直接致函三家平台 CEO 并以国会立法相威胁，可能推动美国围绕 AI 生成私密影像的监管与平台问责进一步收紧。
items.why_en: Speculation: senators directly pressing three platform CEOs and threatening congressional action could push US regulation and platform accountability on AI-generated intimate imagery to tighten further.

items.title_zh: 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格：随着 AI 需要“一万倍的效率飞跃”，渐进式芯片性能提升无法满足
items.title_en: Ex-Intel CEO Gelsinger: incremental chip gains won't suffice as AI needs a '10,000x efficiency leap'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据 Wccftech 报道，前英特尔首席执行官帕特 · 基辛格（Pat Gelsinger）表示，随着人工智能需要“ 10,000 倍的效率飞跃 ”，渐进式的芯片增益将无法满足需求，他同时否认了摩尔定律已走向终结。 在 2026 年 COSM 科技峰会上，帕特 · 基辛格出席了一场题为“现实检验：超越芯片（Reality Check: Beyond Chips）”的炉边谈话。 基辛格在谈话中反驳了半导体微缩已触及物理极限的观点， 他认为 AI 需要的不是常规的代际升级，而是计算效率实现激进的 10,000 倍跃升 。他还指出，摩尔定律（Moore’s Law）能否重焕生机，取决于五大核心工程领域（IT之家注：光学、供电、散热、材料和封装）的根本性突破。 峰会结束后，帕特 · 基辛格在 X 上写道：“ 摩尔定律已死？我说现在是唤醒它的时候了 ！”尽管一些行业观察人士可能会认为传统的摩尔定律微缩已经结束，但基辛格坚持认为半导体工程正在进入一个多学科创新的新时代，他表示：“在半导体行业工作 40 多年后，我相信我们最伟大的创新仍在前方！” 自 2025 年 3 月以普通合伙人身份加入风险投资机构 Playground Global 以来，基辛格一直在积极支持针对这些硬件瓶颈的初创企业，其中包括获得美国政府支持的光刻初创企业 xLight（该公司目标突破阿斯麦 ASML 的 13.5 纳米极紫外 EUV 波长壁垒），以及核能产能公司 Alva Energy。 除了光刻与发电领域，基辛格的技术路线图还瞄准了光互连与硅光子技术，旨在用光信号替代传统的铜线来传输数据。 相关阅读： 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格称 HBM 是“糟糕的内存” 》 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格押注新 AI 内存：Z2RAM 拟绕开 EUV 光刻，4 年内送样 》
items.summary_en: According to Wccftech, former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said incremental chip gains will not be enough as AI requires a "10,000x efficiency leap," while rejecting the idea that Moore's Law is dead. At the 2026 COSM tech summit, Gelsinger took part in a fireside chat titled "Reality Check: Beyond Chips," pushing back on the view that semiconductor scaling has hit physical limits and arguing that AI needs not routine generational upgrades but a radical 10,000x jump in computing efficiency. He also said whether Moore's Law can be revived depends on fundamental breakthroughs in five core engineering areas: optics, power delivery, thermal management, materials and packaging. After the summit, Gelsinger wrote on X: "Moore's Law is dead? I say it's time to wake it up!" He said that after more than 40 years in the semiconductor industry, he believes the greatest innovations are still ahead. Since joining venture firm Playground Global as a general partner in March 2025, Gelsinger has backed startups targeting these hardware bottlenecks, including US-government-backed lithography startup xLight, which aims to break ASML's 13.5nm extreme ultraviolet (EUV) wavelength barrier, and nuclear capacity company Alva Energy. Beyond lithography and power generation, his roadmap also targets optical interconnects and silicon photonics, aiming to replace traditional copper wiring with optical signals for data transmission.
items.why_zh: 推测：作为前英特尔掌门人，基辛格提出的“万倍效率”目标与五大工程瓶颈，可能影响产业界对后摩尔时代技术路线与投资方向的判断。
items.why_en: Speculation: coming from a former Intel chief, Gelsinger's '10,000x efficiency' target and five engineering bottlenecks may influence industry views on post-Moore technology roadmaps and investment directions.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据 Wccftech 报道，前英特尔首席执行官帕特 · 基辛格（Pat Gelsinger）表示，随着人工智能需要“ 10,000 倍的效率飞跃 ”，渐进式的芯片增益将无法满足需求，他同时否认了摩尔定律已走向终结。 在 2026 年 COSM 科技峰会上，帕特 · 基辛格出席了一场题为“现实检验：超越芯片（Reality Check: Beyond Chips）”的炉边谈话。 基辛格在谈话中反驳了半导体微缩已触及物理极限的观点， 他认为 AI 需要的不是常规的代际升级，而是计算效率实现激进的 10,000 倍跃升 。他还指出，摩尔定律（Moore’s Law）能否重焕生机，取决于五大核心工程领域（IT之家注：光学、供电、散热、材料和封装）的根本性突破。 峰会结束后，帕特 · 基辛格在 X 上写道：“ 摩尔定律已死？我说现在是唤醒它的时候了 ！”尽管一些行业观察人士可能会认为传统的摩尔定律微缩已经结束，但基辛格坚持认为半导体工程正在进入一个多学科创新的新时代，他表示：“在半导体行业工作 40 多年后，我相信我们最伟大的创新仍在前方！” 自 2025 年 3 月以普通合伙人身份加入风险投资机构 Playground Global 以来，基辛格一直在积极支持针对这些硬件瓶颈的初创企业，其中包括获得美国政府支持的光刻初创企业 xLight（该公司目标突破阿斯麦 ASML 的 13.5 纳米极紫外 EUV 波长壁垒），以及核能产能公司 Alva Energy。 除了光刻与发电领域，基辛格的技术路线图还瞄准了光互连与硅光子技术，旨在用光信号替代传统的铜线来传输数据。 相关阅读： 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格称 HBM 是“糟糕的内存” 》 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格押注新 AI 内存：Z2RAM 拟绕开 EUV 光刻，4 年内送样 》

items.title_zh: “大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里谈 AI 股暴跌：我早就提醒过你们了
items.title_en: Michael Burry on AI stock plunge: 'I tried to warn you'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，“大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里在 X 平台发文称：“CoreWeave、Nebius、英伟达，还有半导体股，我都试着提醒过大家。我没让你们做空，但我提供的信息 足以让你们决定卖出股票 。” 当地时间 20 日开盘，英伟达股价下跌约 4%（最高跌幅达 14%），CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的跌幅均在 7% 左右。 据《商业内幕》报道，自 10 月 6 日触及盘中高点以来，英伟达、CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的股价分别下跌约 42%、55% 和 65%。本轮 AI 股回调始于 10 月 7 日，同期纽约证券交易所半导体指数累计下跌约 30%。 11 月 11 日，黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 职务的前一天，伯里在 Substack 发文 呼吁股东卖出英伟达股票 。他预测，随着频频促成交易的黄仁勋离任，英伟达的 增长将放缓，利润率也将收窄 。 11 月 12 日，伯里又将警告范围扩大到 Nebius 和 CoreWeave 等英伟达合作伙伴。此类企业被称为“新型云服务商 / 新云服务商”， 主要通过建设数据中心，向客户出租英伟达芯片及其他 AI 基础设施的使用权 。 伯里指出，英伟达的市场影响力和慷慨扶持让这些企业受益匪浅，但这种局面似乎发生了根本变化。 早在 8 月 12 日，伯里就曾断言：“Nebius 就是繁荣行情见顶的写照。” Nebius 当天的收盘价为 259 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,733 元人民币） ，比 11 月 19 日的收盘价高出 62%。 再往前一周，伯里 8 月 6 日称自己 忍不住想做空 Nebius 和甲骨文 ，认为做空两家公司简直易如反掌。今年，他还做空过英伟达、CoreWeave 及半导体指数。 伯里一年前不再经营对冲基金，转而通过 Substack 分享个人投资观点。此后，他始终对 AI 股票的暴涨持公开怀疑态度。 作为一名逆向投资者，伯里曾是少数 成功预见 2008 年房地产泡沫破裂并从中获利 的人之一。他一直警告，AI 企业对芯片、数据中心等折旧迅速的资产投入过多资金。 伯里还批评 AI 企业采用激进的会计处理手法、开展循环融资交易，并背负着危险规模的债务和表外负债。 此次，伯里再次在 X 平台强调，他对英伟达及其合作伙伴和同行的担忧远不止黄仁勋涉嫌婚外情，以及民主党控制参众两院后可能出现的对 AI 行业不利的政治环境。“如果你还觉得这一切只是婚外情和政治问题，那就说明你 想得还不够深 。”
items.summary_en: ITHome reported on Nov. 21 that 'Big Short' investor Michael Burry wrote on X: 'CoreWeave, Nebius, Nvidia, and semiconductor stocks — I tried to warn everyone. I didn't tell you to short them, but the information I provided was enough for you to decide to sell the stocks.' According to the article, at the open on the 20th local time, Nvidia fell about 4%, while CoreWeave and Nebius each fell around 7%. Business Insider reported that since hitting intraday highs on Oct. 6, Nvidia, CoreWeave and Nebius shares had fallen about 42%, 55% and 65%, respectively; the AI stock pullback began on Oct. 7, and the NYSE Semiconductor Index fell about 30% over the same period. The article also said that on Nov. 11, the day before Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, Burry wrote on Substack urging shareholders to sell Nvidia stock and predicted that with Huang's departure, Nvidia's growth would slow and margins would narrow. On Nov. 12, Burry widened the warning to Nvidia partners including Nebius and CoreWeave; such firms are called 'neoclouds,' mainly building data centers to rent out Nvidia chips and other AI infrastructure to customers. Burry said Nvidia's market influence and generous support had greatly benefited these firms, but that situation appeared to have fundamentally changed. As early as Aug. 12, Burry said 'Nebius is the picture of a boom topping out'; Nebius closed at $259 that day, 62% above its Nov. 19 close. A week earlier, on Aug. 6, Burry said he could not resist shorting Nebius and Oracle and viewed shorting both as very easy. This year he also shorted Nvidia, CoreWeave and the semiconductor index. Burry stopped running a hedge fund a year ago and began sharing personal investment views via Substack; since then he has been openly skeptical of the AI stock surge. As a contrarian investor, he was among the few who successfully foresaw and profited from the mid-2000s housing bubble bust; he has warned that AI companies are investing too much in rapidly depreciating assets such as chips and data centers. Burry has also criticized AI companies for aggressive accounting, circular financing deals, and dangerous levels of debt and off-balance-sheet liabilities. In this latest post on X, Burry stressed that his concerns about Nvidia, its partners and peers go far beyond Huang's alleged extramarital affair and the potentially unfavorable political environment for AI if Democrats control both chambers of Congress: 'If you still think this is just about an affair and politics, then you're not thinking deeply enough.'

items.title_zh: 代码显示三星正为 One UI 9.5 开发 AI 智能天气提醒功能：可根据用户作息与通勤时间推送通知
items.title_en: Code shows Samsung is developing AI smart weather alerts for One UI 9.5 that push notifications based on users' routines and commute
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，外媒 SammyGuru 在拆解三星最新 One UI 9.5 测试版时，发现三星正在为天气应用测试多项 AI 智能提醒功能，系统能够识别用户的起床时间和通勤行为，在用户起床、上班或下班回家时自动加载最新天气信息。 具体来看，相应功能依赖三星 Personal Data Intelligence（个人数据智能）系统，能够识别用户早晨何时起床、何时开始通勤，当系统检测到用户离开家或工作地点时，天气应用便会向用户自动弹出天气预报卡片。 在隐私方面，相应代码字符串显示 Personal Data Intelligence 会在用户设备本地分析位置数据，但用户的经纬度信息仍会分享给三星天气数据服务提供商 The Weather Channel，该服务商只会将位置数据用于提供天气信息，不会与第三方分享。 除了天气应用，三星还计划让 One UI 9.5 中的其他功能了解用户的日常通勤习惯。外媒 Android Authority 此前发现，三星为新版系统悄悄新增一项“三星驾驶报告（Driving Report）”功能，该功能能够在用户驾车出行前提前检查天气状况和睡眠评分，并在用户出发时间前约 1 小时推送相关提醒。 结合本次天气应用新增的通勤天气预测功能来看，三星似乎希望通过 One UI 9.5 更全面地学习用户的日常作息和出行规律，从而提供更加主动的个性化服务，预计这些功能将于明年年初 Galaxy S27 系列发布时在 One UI 9.5 正式版上线。
items.summary_en: According to SammyGuru, while breaking down Samsung's latest One UI 9.5 beta, it found Samsung is testing several AI smart reminder features for its weather app; the system can recognize users' wake-up times and commuting behavior and automatically load the latest weather information when users wake up, go to work or head home. The feature relies on Samsung's Personal Data Intelligence system, which can identify when users get up in the morning and when they start commuting; when it detects the user leaving home or the workplace, the weather app automatically pops up a forecast card. On privacy, code strings show that Personal Data Intelligence analyzes location data locally on the device, but the user's latitude and longitude are still shared with Samsung's weather data provider The Weather Channel, which uses the location data only to provide weather information and does not share it with third parties. Besides the weather app, Samsung plans to let other One UI 9.5 features learn users' daily commuting habits; Android Authority previously found Samsung quietly added a "Driving Report" feature that checks weather conditions and sleep scores before a drive and pushes a reminder about an hour before departure. Combined with the new commute-weather prediction, Samsung appears to want One UI 9.5 to learn users' daily routines and travel patterns more comprehensively to offer more proactive personalized services; the features are expected to launch in the stable One UI 9.5 with the Galaxy S27 series early next year.
items.why_zh: 推测：若按代码线索落地，这显示手机厂商正把本地个人数据分析用于主动式服务，同时把位置数据外发给第三方天气服务商，隐私边界值得关注。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the code findings materialize, this shows phone makers using on-device personal data analysis for proactive services while still sending location data to a third-party weather provider, making the privacy boundary worth watching.

items.title_zh: 手机测试产线部署智元精灵 G2 机器人，智元与蓝思科技达成战略合作
items.title_en: AGIBOT and Lens Technology partner to deploy AgiBot G2 robots on phone testing line
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，智元创新（AGIBOT）与蓝思科技达成战略合作， 于手机测试产线部署智元精灵 G2 机器人 ，数十台机器人同时进行测试工位自动上下料、测试设备交互等工作。 据介绍，精灵 G2 可实现手机产品全自动转运、智能分拨与高效上下料。对比传统自动化设备，精灵 G2 通用本体可兼容多条作业产线，大幅降低产线改造成本。同时，精灵 G2 支持全天候不间断作业，可承接重复性工序，有效缓解用工压力，为 3C 精密制造带来降本、提效、提质的综合价值。 官方表示，本次工业部署态落地聚焦手机 MMI、ANT、CAM、CAMCV 等测试，这类岗位具备操作重复性高、机型迭代快等特征，完整跑通工艺适配、产线联调、交付落地全链路，沉淀标准化交付流程与项目实施体系，具备极强的 1-N 规模化复制潜力。 据IT之家此前报道，去年 10 月， 智元发布工业级交互式具身作业机器人智元精灵 G2 ，搭载英伟达 Jetson Thor 芯片，配备高精度力控双臂，拥有 19 自由度的灵巧手和 3D 触觉感知，5 自由度腰腿搭配全向底盘，引入真机 RL 工具链。 今年 6 月 23 日至 28 日，智元精灵 G2 机器人在龙旗科技南昌工厂产线开启“平板量产质检工段全覆盖”真实产线直播， 机器人作业成功率 99.99% 。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: AGIBOT and Lens Technology announced a strategic partnership to deploy AgiBot G2 robots on a phone testing production line, with dozens of robots simultaneously performing automatic loading/unloading at test stations and interacting with test equipment. The G2 can handle fully automated transfer, intelligent sorting and efficient loading/unloading of phone products. Compared with traditional automation equipment, its general-purpose body can be compatible with multiple production lines, greatly reducing line retrofit costs. It supports all-weather uninterrupted operation and can take on repetitive processes, easing labor pressure and bringing cost reduction, efficiency and quality improvements to 3C precision manufacturing. The company says the industrial deployment focuses on phone MMI, ANT, CAM, CAMCV and other tests, which feature high repetitiveness and fast model iteration; it has completed process adaptation, line commissioning and delivery, accumulating a standardized delivery process and implementation system with strong 1-to-N scaling potential. IT Home previously reported that in October last year AGIBOT launched the industrial-grade interactive embodied robot AgiBot G2, with Nvidia Jetson Thor chip, high-precision force-controlled dual arms, 19-DOF dexterous hands and 3D tactile sensing, 5-DOF waist/legs with omnidirectional chassis, and a real-machine RL toolchain. From June 23 to 28 this year, the G2 ran a real production-line livestream at Longcheer's Nanchang factory covering full coverage of tablet mass-production quality inspection, with a 99.99% operation success rate.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，律师 u/TumbleweedNew6515 昨日（11 月 20 日）在 Reddit 社区发帖，斥资 9,450 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 63,239 元人民币） 使用 12 张二手英伟达 V100 显卡搭建私人 AI 服务器，本地运行 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，集群最高吞吐量达到每秒 184 个词元。 在硬件部分，该律师使用 12 张英伟达 NVIDIA Tesla V100 SXM2 32GB 搭建，通过 NVLink 与 PCIe 组成可协同推理的本地 AI 集群，整套硬件采购价约 9,450 美元 （现汇率约合 63,239 元人民币） 。 这套系统采用 3 个流水线阶段（PP3）× 每阶段 4 卡张量并行（TP4）的结构，系统运行的是 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，并采用 4-bit NVFP4 量化。发帖者称，每个专家被压缩至约 15,360 个参数，使 12 张 V100 能分别承载模型中的专家分片。 配置 3× DGX Spark（TP3、SGLang、MXFP4 专家） 4× DGX Spark（TP4；三堆叠） 12× V100（本次配置） 单请求，代码 未发布 125（SGLang）/ 138（TensorFold 4.0 bpw）/ 136（vLLM + DSpark） 153–184 单请求，普通文本 38–51 79–88 83–95 预填充，长提示词 约 2,000 3,100–3,300（TensorFold）/ 4,900–5,000（SGLang，真实文本）/ 8,500（vLLM + DSpark，32K–128K） 4,500–4,700 多请求 4 个流合计 85 32 个流时 290（TensorFold）/ 16 个流时 340–570（SGLang，从散文到结构化） 3 个流时 344–443；它不是批量解码引擎 上下文 配置为 256K 1M 配置为 524K 性能方面，该网友的测试结果如下： 上下文长度 首个 token（冷启动） 预填充速度（tok/s） 代码 法律 普通文本 三个代码请求合计 首个 token（文档已缓存） 1K 0.7 秒 1,567 184 102 86 443 0.2 秒 8K 2.5 秒 3,267 176 93 90 421 0.2 秒 32K 7.3 秒 4,478 176 92 95 404 0.3 秒 64K 13.9 秒 4,697 157 93 83 364 0.3 秒 128K 28.1 秒 4,670 157 93 86 360 0.4 秒 256K 58.0 秒 4,518 153 92 85 344 0.6 秒 这位用户称，在单请求、单流场景下，该服务器优于已公开的 4 台英伟达 DGX Spark 组合，代码生成速度快约 15% 至 45%，普通文本生成速度也更高。 整套系统成本约 9,450 美元 （现汇率约合 63,239 元人民币） ，约为三台 DGX Spark 组合价格的一半；不过，其代价是功耗最高可达约 2,100W，且噪音较大，并不适合普通办公环境。 参考 Lawyer with too many GPUs: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 12x V100, all 15,360 experts in NVFP4 on the cards. 157-184 tok/s on one code stream, faster than any published 4x DGX Spark stack and double 3 Sparks, for half the price of 3 Sparks. 128K file read in 28 s.
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: Lawyer u/TumbleweedNew6515 posted on Reddit on Nov 20 that he spent $9,450 (about 63,239 yuan) to build a private AI server with 12 used Nvidia V100 GPUs, running DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash locally, with cluster throughput reaching up to 184 tokens per second. The hardware uses 12 NVIDIA Tesla V100 SXM2 32GB cards connected via NVLink and PCIe into a local cluster for collaborative inference. The system uses 3 pipeline stages (PP3) x 4-card tensor parallelism per stage (TP4), runs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and uses 4-bit NVFP4 quantization. The poster says each expert is compressed to about 15,360 parameters, allowing the 12 V100s to each carry expert shards of the model. Tests show cold-start first token at 0.7 seconds for 1K context and 58.0 seconds for 256K; prefill speed around 1,567 to 4,697 tok/s; single-request code generation 153-184 tok/s and ordinary text 83-95 tok/s. The poster says that in single-request, single-stream scenarios the server outperforms published 4x Nvidia DGX Spark setups, with code generation about 15%-45% faster and higher ordinary-text generation. The whole system costs about $9,450, roughly half the price of a three-DGX-Spark setup; the trade-offs are power draw of up to about 2,100W and high noise, making it unsuitable for ordinary office environments.

items.title_zh: 拯救爆满的“下载”文件夹：微软 Win11 将推 AI 整理神器，授权后可查找 / 分类 / 移动 / 重命名文件
items.title_en: Rescuing the Overflowing Downloads Folder: Microsoft Win11 to Add AI File Organizer That Can Find, Categorize, Move and Rename Files After Authorization
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Latest 昨日（11 月 20 日）发布博文，报道称在 Ignite 2026 活动中，微软展示 Copilot“本地文件操作”功能， 在征得用户授权后可以查找、分类、移动或重命名本地文件。 IT之家附上相关视频如下： 微软表示该功能可以减少手动翻找和归类的麻烦，用户主动启用并授权后，即可用日常语言要求 AI 查找、移动文件、创建文件和文件夹，还能根据文件内容批量重命名。 在本次演示中，微软为了便于和团队成员分享内容，要求将“下载”文件夹里的分析师报告整理到 OneDrive。微软 Copilot 请求权限后，扫描相关目录，在 OneDrive 中创建“Analyst Reports”文件夹，随后逐一移入 8 份 PDF，并列出移动记录，提供撤销按钮。 报道指出，演示中的 8 份文件，其名称均未直接出现“分析师报告”字样，Copilot 通过读取内容识别出符合要求的资料。用户因此不必记住准确文件名，只需描述要找什么，再由 AI 完成筛选与整理。 在权限边界方面，演示中的授权界面提供“暂不允许”和“仅本次会话允许”两个选项，没有“始终允许”，且访问范围限于当前对话及相关目录，无法一次授权便能读取整台电脑。
items.summary_en: Tech media Windows Latest published a post on November 20 reporting that at the Ignite 2026 event Microsoft demonstrated a Copilot "local file operations" feature that, after user authorization, can find, categorize, move or rename local files. Microsoft says the feature reduces the hassle of manually searching and sorting; after users actively enable and authorize it, they can use everyday language to ask the AI to find and move files, create files and folders, and batch-rename files based on their content. In the demo, to make it easier to share content with team members, Microsoft asked Copilot to organize analyst reports in the Downloads folder into OneDrive. After requesting permission, Copilot scanned the relevant directory, created an "Analyst Reports" folder in OneDrive, moved 8 PDFs in one by one, listed the move records and offered an undo button. The report noted that none of the 8 file names in the demo directly contained the words "analyst report"; Copilot identified the matching materials by reading their content. Users therefore need not remember exact file names, only describe what they are looking for, and the AI completes the filtering and organizing. On permission boundaries, the authorization interface in the demo offered "not now" and "allow for this session only" options, with no "always allow," and access was limited to the current conversation and related directories, so a single authorization cannot read the entire PC.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该功能落地，AI助手将从“对话”进一步介入本地文件系统操作，权限设计（无“始终允许”、限定目录、可撤销）可能成为同类功能的风向标。
items.why_en: Speculation: if shipped, the feature would move AI assistants from conversation into operating on the local file system, and its permission design (no "always allow," scoped directories, undo) could set a precedent for similar features.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 公布反蒸馏防护进展：GPT-6.2 Astra 思考链提取成功率从 54% 降至 0.2%
items.title_en: OpenAI Reports Anti-Distillation Progress: GPT-6.2 Astra Chain-of-Thought Extraction Success Rate Falls From 54% to 0.2%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，OpenAI 发布公告介绍了针对「对抗性蒸馏」（Adversarial Distillation）的防御措施。 OpenAI 称其已加强 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 对内部推理思考链（Chain-of-Thought）的保护，以降低其他模型通过提取推理过程获取其能力的风险。 OpenAI 表示，对抗性蒸馏是指未经授权地利用前沿 AI 模型的输出训练其他模型，使后者获得相似能力，却不具备原模型相应的安全防护。该行为可能导致网络安全、生物学等领域的高风险能力被转移到安全限制较弱的模型中。 在内部自适应黑盒红队测试中，OpenAI 测试了攻击者提取模型此前请求和当前请求中受保护推理内容的成功率。 结果显示，针对此前请求推理内容的提取成功率，从 GPT-6 Astra 原有安全机制下的 54.0%，降至 GPT-6.2 Astra 更新安全机制后的 0.2%；针对当前请求推理内容的提取成功率，则从 22.9% 降至 0.9%。测试结果汇总了 6 个攻击模型的数据。 为实现上述防护，OpenAI 采用了多层措施，包括通过对抗性训练让模型识别并拒绝推理链提取请求，利用输入和输出分类器检测相关攻击及推理内容泄露，以及通过 API 限制不同会话、模型和组织之间的推理内容复用。IT之家附图如下： 其中，GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 会将受保护的推理内容与生成它的对话历史关联起来。如果此前的消息被修改，API 会丢弃基于该消息生成的后续推理内容。此外，安全防护较弱的旧版模型也无法读取这两个新模型的受保护推理内容。 在针对相关行为的执法方面， OpenAI 称，今年以来，公司每周都会对涉及未经授权蒸馏活动的账号采取措施，规模从数千个到数万个不等 ，今年夏季以来相关执法规模明显增加。公司还会调查协调进行大规模提取的账号网络，并与其他模型提供商分享攻击指标，以协助识别相关滥用行为。 OpenAI 还介绍了其对蒸馏安全风险的研究。公司内部测试发现，与仅使用模型最终回答、推理摘要和工具交互记录训练的学生模型相比，使用教师模型完整推理轨迹进行监督微调的学生模型，通常能够获得更好的网络安全能力迁移效果。 相关阅读： 《 菲尔兹奖得主邓煜评论 AI 公司反蒸馏：你不能只在你蒸馏全人类知识时支持蒸馏 》 《 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋回应 AI 模型蒸馏争议：这是市场竞争行为 》 《 商务部回应美方所谓 AI 蒸馏指控：于事无凭于法无据，典型双重标准 》 《 消息称张一鸣内部下死命令：就算模型暂时落后，字节跳动也不会依赖 AI 蒸馏技术 》 《 微软 CEO 纳德拉批评 AI 模型公司“双标”：一边主张“合理使用”数据，一边限制他人蒸馏 》
items.summary_en: On November 20 local time, OpenAI published an announcement describing defenses against "adversarial distillation." OpenAI said it has strengthened protection of the internal chain-of-thought reasoning of GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to reduce the risk of other models obtaining their capabilities by extracting the reasoning process. OpenAI said adversarial distillation refers to unauthorized use of frontier AI model outputs to train other models so that they gain similar capabilities without the original model's corresponding safeguards; this could transfer high-risk capabilities in areas such as cybersecurity and biology to models with weaker safety constraints. In internal adaptive black-box red-team tests, OpenAI tested attackers' success rates at extracting protected reasoning content from earlier requests and current requests. Results showed the extraction success rate for reasoning in earlier requests fell from 54.0% under GPT-6 Astra's original safeguards to 0.2% after GPT-6.2 Astra's updated safeguards; for current requests it fell from 22.9% to 0.9%. The results aggregated data from 6 attacking models. To achieve this, OpenAI used multiple layers of measures, including adversarial training so models recognize and refuse reasoning-extraction requests, input and output classifiers to detect such attacks and reasoning leakage, and API restrictions on reuse of reasoning content across sessions, models and organizations. GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol tie protected reasoning content to the conversation history that produced it; if earlier messages are modified, the API discards subsequent reasoning content generated from that message. In addition, older models with weaker safeguards cannot read the protected reasoning content of these two new models. On enforcement, OpenAI said that this year it has taken action weekly against accounts involved in unauthorized distillation, ranging from thousands to tens of thousands, with enforcement notably increasing since the summer. It also investigates networks of accounts coordinating large-scale extraction and shares attack indicators with other model providers to help identify abuse. OpenAI also described its research on distillation safety risks: internal tests found that student models supervised-fine-tuned on a teacher model's full reasoning traces generally achieve better transfer of cybersecurity capabilities than student models trained only on final answers, reasoning summaries and tool-interaction records.

items.source_title: OpenAI 公布反蒸馏防护进展：GPT-6.2 Astra 思考链提取成功率从 54% 降至 0.2%
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，OpenAI 发布公告介绍了针对「对抗性蒸馏」（Adversarial Distillation）的防御措施。 OpenAI 称其已加强 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 对内部推理思考链（Chain-of-Thought）的保护，以降低其他模型通过提取推理过程获取其能力的风险。 OpenAI 表示，对抗性蒸馏是指未经授权地利用前沿 AI 模型的输出训练其他模型，使后者获得相似能力，却不具备原模型相应的安全防护。该行为可能导致网络安全、生物学等领域的高风险能力被转移到安全限制较弱的模型中。 在内部自适应黑盒红队测试中，OpenAI 测试了攻击者提取模型此前请求和当前请求中受保护推理内容的成功率。 结果显示，针对此前请求推理内容的提取成功率，从 GPT-6 Astra 原有安全机制下的 54.0%，降至 GPT-6.2 Astra 更新安全机制后的 0.2%；针对当前请求推理内容的提取成功率，则从 22.9% 降至 0.9%。测试结果汇总了 6 个攻击模型的数据。 为实现上述防护，OpenAI 采用了多层措施，包括通过对抗性训练让模型识别并拒绝推理链提取请求，利用输入和输出分类器检测相关攻击及推理内容泄露，以及通过 API 限制不同会话、模型和组织之间的推理内容复用。IT之家附图如下： 其中，GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 会将受保护的推理内容与生成它的对话历史关联起来。如果此前的消息被修改，API 会丢弃基于该消息生成的后续推理内容。此外，安全防护较弱的旧版模型也无法读取这两个新模型的受保护推理内容。 在针对相关行为的执法方面， OpenAI 称，今年以来，公司每周都会对涉及未经授权蒸馏活动的账号采取措施，规模从数千个到数万个不等 ，今年夏季以来相关执法规模明显增加。公司还会调查协调进行大规模提取的账号网络，并与其他模型提供商分享攻击指标，以协助识别相关滥用行为。 OpenAI 还介绍了其对蒸馏安全风险的研究。公司内部测试发现，与仅使用模型最终回答、推理摘要和工具交互记录训练的学生模型相比，使用教师模型完整推理轨迹进行监督微调的学生模型，通常能够获得更好的网络安全能力迁移效果。 相关阅读： 《 菲尔兹奖得主邓煜评论 AI 公司反蒸馏：你不能只在你蒸馏全人类知识时支持蒸馏 》 《 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋回应 AI 模型蒸馏争议：这是市场竞争行为 》 《 商务部回应美方所谓 AI 蒸馏指控：于事无凭于法无据，典型双重标准 》 《 消息称张一鸣内部下死命令：就算模型暂时落后，字节跳动也不会依赖 AI 蒸馏技术 》 《 微软 CEO 纳德拉批评 AI 模型公司“双标”：一边主张“合理使用”数据，一边限制他人蒸馏 》

items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 MedChemBench 基准，评估 AI 辅助药物研发能力
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches MedChemBench Benchmark to Evaluate AI in Drug Discovery
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，OpenAI 发布 MedChemBench 基准，用于评估 AI 模型在药物化学研究中的推理能力，包括识别分子结构、解读实验结果、比较化合物及预测其性质等。OpenAI 表示，模型在重建分子结构和解释实验依据方面表现较强，但在化合物筛选和数值性质预测方面仍有明显提升空间。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，该基准包含 99 道题目 ，取自 117 篇论文与专利，涉及 761 个不同分子结构。多数题目向模型提供研究进行到某一节点时的上下文，包括生物靶点、研究人员的目标、此前研究过的化合物与部分实验结果。 官方将评测分为四个部分，IT之家附具体内容如下： 分子结构：依据题目给出的结构图与化学基团组装分子，考察原子连接与立体化学是否正确； 科学解释：解释需由给定证据支撑，例如为何在若干化合物中选择某一个； 排序与选择：化合物排序与最终选择是否符合题目要求； 性质预测：与原始材料给出的数值、类别是否一致，涵盖实测与计算得到的分子性质。 据官方公布信息，在 xhigh 推理档下，GPT-6.2 Astra 获得 84.5% 的可用分数，GPT-6 Astra 为 83.3%，GPT-6.1 Sol 为 82.0%，GPT-5.6 Sol 为 58.2%。官方称，提高推理档位可带来分数提升，但模型之间的差距依然明显。 分项表现上，Astra 在 xhigh 档的分子结构部分拿到 95.4% 的可用分数，而在化合物选择与数值性质预测两项上仅获约一半分数。 官方举例称，一道题目要求模型以给定中心结构与两个侧基组装分子，并保留一个 18 原子环。 在 11 个模型共用的 xhigh 档下， GPT-6 Astra 的十次回答全部正确 ；GPT-5.6 Sol 与 GPT-5.6 Luna 十次全部出错，前者组装出的环只有 15 个原子，后者把分子拆成两个互不相连的片段。 另一道题取材于 PRMT5 抑制剂研究，PRMT5 是肿瘤药物研发中受到关注的蛋白。模型需要预测三种相关化合物在细胞内阻断 PRMT5 的强度、穿过细胞屏障的难易，以及在实验室检测中被肝酶降解的速度。 官方在题目中隐去的后续实验显示存在取舍：化合物 23 在更低浓度下即可在细胞内阻断 PRMT5，化合物 24 更易穿过细胞屏障，在肝酶检测中的降解速度也更慢。 官方表示， 这些结果并不能确定模型是否能够发现新药或改善实验室决策 。不能排除之前接触过已发表资料的可能性，每一次回应都是一次没有工具、没有反馈或新实验的尝试。虽然基准测试基于历史证据而非真实药物发现，其结果有助于识别模型在哪些方面进展，哪些仍面临挑战。团队相信 MedChemBench 将支持持续的进步，并期待随着模型的进步与应用领域分享最新进展。
items.summary_en: On November 20 local time, OpenAI released the MedChemBench benchmark to evaluate AI models' reasoning in medicinal chemistry research, including identifying molecular structures, interpreting experimental results, comparing compounds and predicting their properties. OpenAI said models perform relatively well at reconstructing molecular structures and explaining experimental evidence, but still have clear room for improvement in compound screening and numerical property prediction. The benchmark contains 99 questions drawn from 117 papers and patents, involving 761 distinct molecular structures. Most questions give the model context at a certain point in a research project, including the biological target, the researchers' goals, previously studied compounds and some experimental results. The evaluation has four parts: molecular structure (assembling a molecule from a given structural diagram and chemical groups, checking atom connectivity and stereochemistry); scientific explanation (explanations must be supported by given evidence, e.g., why one compound was chosen among several); ranking and selection (whether compound rankings and final choices match the task); and property prediction (whether values and categories match the original material, covering measured and computed molecular properties). According to published results, at the xhigh reasoning setting GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% usable score, GPT-6 Astra 83.3%, GPT-6.1 Sol 82.0%, and GPT-5.6 Sol 58.2%. OpenAI said higher reasoning settings bring score gains, but gaps between models remain clear. By section, Astra at xhigh scored 95.4% on molecular structure but only about half on compound selection and numerical property prediction. OpenAI gave an example where a question asked the model to assemble a molecule from a given central structure and two side groups while preserving an 18-atom ring; at the xhigh setting shared by 11 models, GPT-6 Astra answered correctly all ten times, while GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna were wrong all ten times — the former assembled a ring of only 15 atoms, the latter split the molecule into two disconnected fragments. Another question drew on PRMT5 inhibitor research, PRMT5 being a protein of interest in oncology drug development. The model had to predict how strongly three related compounds block PRMT5 in cells, how easily they cross cell barriers, and how fast they are degraded by liver enzymes in lab assays. Follow-up experiments withheld from the prompt showed trade-offs: compound 23 blocks PRMT5 in cells at lower concentrations, while compound 24 crosses cell barriers more easily and degrades more slowly in the liver enzyme assay. OpenAI said these results cannot determine whether models can discover new drugs or improve lab decisions; prior exposure to published material cannot be ruled out, and each response is a single attempt with no tools, feedback or new experiments. Although the benchmark is based on historical evidence rather than real drug discovery, its results help identify where models are progressing and where challenges remain. The team believes MedChemBench will support continued progress and looks forward to sharing updates as models improve and with the application field.
items.why_zh: 推测：该基准把药物化学推理拆成结构、解释、选择与性质预测四类可量化任务，或为评估AI在科研场景的能力边界提供参照，但官方也提示其基于历史证据、不能等同于真实药物发现能力。
items.why_en: Speculation: the benchmark breaks medicinal-chemistry reasoning into four measurable task types — structure, explanation, selection and property prediction — potentially offering a reference for AI capability limits in research, though OpenAI notes it is based on historical evidence and is not equivalent to real drug-discovery ability.

items.title_zh: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
items.title_en: Did Claude Really Prove the Riemann Hypothesis? Anthropic Mathematician Releases Only Lean Code as Terence Tao Says Verification Will Take Time
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 数学家莱文特 · 阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge）宣称他与 Claude 合作，发现了黎曼猜想及其推广形式广义黎曼猜想（GRH）的证明。 阿尔珀格拥有哈佛大学本科学位和普林斯顿大学数学博士学位，目前在 Anthropic 从事研究工作。他在声明中称，Claude 在证明接近完成时“远远超过了我”，“在终点附近飞翔、跳舞、闪耀”。他还表示，自己为 Claude 指明了关键研究方向，随后 Claude 提出了一系列令他意外的数学思路。 据阿尔珀格透露，他与 Claude 生成的文字证明超过 25 万页，因篇幅过长未予公开。公开材料仅包括一份 4 页说明，以及分为 14 个压缩包、总计约 1700 万行的 Lean 形式化代码。 2006 年菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩后续在个人博客中对此作了初步盘点。他表示，从非常初步的分析看，该证明似乎动用了朗兰兹纲领和算术几何领域的现代研究成果，数学界梳理核心思路并验证正确性的过程还需要一段时间。 罗格斯大学数学教授 Alex Kontorovich 则在 X 上称，黎曼猜想的证明需要“运用一切”，这反而让他对成功的可能性更有信心。 IT之家注：Lean 是一种交互式定理证明器，用于将数学证明翻译为计算机可机械验证的代码。Lean 通过小型可信内核逐步检查逻辑推导，但无法自动保证形式化代码所证明的命题与原始数学猜想在语义上完全一致。 数学家 Elliot Glazer 在初步检查后表示，阿尔珀格发布的 Lean 文件中形式化的数学命题“确实是广义黎曼猜想”。但他同时指出，理论上不排除 Lean 自身存在可靠性漏洞的可能，不过他估计这一概率远低于 1%。此前已有研究记录显示，Lean 4 的部分历史版本曾出现过允许无效证明通过的内核缺陷。 《科学》杂志 2026 年 10 月的一篇报道也指出，AI 生成的 Lean 代码曾在 OpenAI 高调的 Navier-Stokes 问题证明中弱化原始英文命题的表述；Lean 验证的仅是代码所指向的形式化目标，而非自然语言层面的数学问题本身。 另外还有网上流传的一张疑似 2026 年菲尔兹奖得主邓煜评价此事的聊天截图显示，面对相关提问，其回复称“至少拿出 500 页版本前看都不看”。 即使 Lean 代码通过编译、形式化目标与原始猜想的一致性也得到确认，距离克雷数学研究所的认可仍有漫长距离。 按照该机构规则，千禧年难题的解答必须在同行评审期刊正式发表，并经过至少两年的验证期和数学界普遍接受，才有可能进入奖金评审程序。个人网站声明和代码压缩包不符合提交资格，克雷数学研究所也不接受直接投稿。黎曼猜想于 2000 年被列入七大千禧年难题，奖金为 100 万美元 （现汇率约合 669.2 万元人民币） 。 值得一提的是，Anthropic 于 11 月 19 日刚在纳斯达克挂牌交易，阿尔珀格称他在 11 月 15 日深夜至 16 日凌晨完成关键工作后联系了 Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊，询问公布时机。他承认“时间点非常糟糕”，但表示“实在无法再等下去了”。 今年 8 月，Anthropic 曾公布 Claude 在黎曼猜想相关问题上将关键线上零点比例下界从 41.6% 提高至 67.2% 的成果，当时距离完整证明仍有明显差距。 相关阅读： 《 AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Anthropic 数学家宣称已与 Claude 合作完成证明 》 《 未公开的新模型“立功”，Anthropic 宣布 Claude 攻克黎曼猜想取得重大突破 》 《 继 Claude 尝试攻克黎曼猜想后：OpenAI 宣布用 10000 个 AI 智能体 88 小时攻克千禧年大奖难题，陶哲轩既点赞又担忧 》 《 悬赏百万美元求证明，这道数学题为啥这么值钱？ 》 《 英国“数学教父”阿蒂亚去世，曾宣称证明黎曼猜想 》
items.summary_en: On November 20 local time, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claimed that, working with Claude, he had found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis and its generalization, the generalized Riemann hypothesis (GRH). Alpöge holds a bachelor's degree from Harvard and a mathematics PhD from Princeton and now does research at Anthropic. In his statement he said Claude "far surpassed me" as the proof neared completion, "flying, dancing and shining near the finish line." He said he pointed Claude toward key research directions, after which Claude produced a series of mathematical ideas that surprised him. According to Alpöge, the text proof he and Claude produced exceeds 250,000 pages and was not released due to its length. Public materials include only a 4-page explanation and roughly 17 million lines of Lean formalization code split across 14 compressed archives. 2006 Fields Medalist Terence Tao later offered a preliminary assessment on his blog, saying that from a very preliminary analysis the proof appears to draw on modern results from the Langlands program and arithmetic geometry, and that it will take the mathematics community some time to sort out the core ideas and verify correctness. Rutgers mathematics professor Alex Kontorovich said on X that proving the Riemann hypothesis requires "using everything," which made him more confident in the possibility of success. Note: Lean is an interactive theorem prover that translates mathematical proofs into machine-checkable code. Lean checks logical deductions step by step through a small trusted kernel, but it cannot automatically guarantee that the proposition proved by the formal code is semantically identical to the original mathematical conjecture. Mathematician Elliot Glazer said after a preliminary check that the mathematical proposition formalized in Alpöge's Lean files "is indeed the generalized Riemann hypothesis," but noted that a soundness bug in Lean itself cannot theoretically be ruled out, though he estimated that probability as far below 1%. Prior research has documented kernel flaws in some historical versions of Lean 4 that allowed invalid proofs to pass. An October 2026 report in Science also noted that AI-generated Lean code weakened the original English statement in OpenAI's high-profile Navier-Stokes proof; Lean verifies only the formal target the code points to, not the natural-language mathematical problem itself. A chat screenshot circulating online, purportedly of 2026 Fields Medalist Deng Yu commenting, showed him replying to a related question that he "wouldn't even look before a 500-page version is produced." Even if the Lean code compiles and the formal target's consistency with the original conjecture is confirmed, recognition by the Clay Mathematics Institute remains a long way off. Under its rules, a solution to a Millennium Prize Problem must be formally published in a peer-reviewed journal and undergo at least a two-year verification period and general acceptance by the mathematics community before it can enter the prize review process. Personal website statements and code archives do not qualify for submission, and the Clay Institute does not accept direct submissions. The Riemann hypothesis was listed among the seven Millennium Prize Problems in 2000, with a prize of $1 million (about 6.692 million yuan at current exchange rates). Notably, Anthropic listed on Nasdaq on November 19; Alpöge said that after completing key work late at night on November 15 into November 16, he contacted Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to ask about timing for publication. items.source_title: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 数学家莱文特 · 阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge）宣称他与 Claude 合作，发现了黎曼猜想及其推广形式广义黎曼猜想（GRH）的证明。 阿尔珀格拥有哈佛大学本科学位和普林斯顿大学数学博士学位，目前在 Anthropic 从事研究工作。他在声明中称，Claude 在证明接近完成时“远远超过了我”，“在终点附近飞翔、跳舞、闪耀”。他还表示，自己为 Claude 指明了关键研究方向，随后 Claude 提出了一系列令他意外的数学思路。 据阿尔珀格透露，他与 Claude 生成的文字证明超过 25 万页，因篇幅过长未予公开。公开材料仅包括一份 4 页说明，以及分为 14 个压缩包、总计约 1700 万行的 Lean 形式化代码。 2006 年菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩后续在个人博客中对此作了初步盘点。他表示，从非常初步的分析看，该证明似乎动用了朗兰兹纲领和算术几何领域的现代研究成果，数学界梳理核心思路并验证正确性的过程还需要一段时间。 罗格斯大学数学教授 Alex Kontorovich 则在 X 上称，黎曼猜想的证明需要“运用一切”，这反而让他对成功的可能性更有信心。 IT之家注：Lean 是一种交互式定理证明器，用于将数学证明翻译为计算机可机械验证的代码。Lean 通过小型可信内核逐步检查逻辑推导，但无法自动保证形式化代码所证明的命题与原始数学猜想在语义上完全一致。 数学家 Elliot Glazer 在初步检查后表示，阿尔珀格发布的 Lean 文件中形式化的数学命题“确实是广义黎曼猜想”。但他同时指出，理论上不排除 Lean 自身存在可靠性漏洞的可能，不过他估计这一概率远低于 1%。此前已有研究记录显示，Lean 4 的部分历史版本曾出现过允许无效证明通过的内核缺陷。 《科学》杂志 2026 年 10 月的一篇报道也指出，AI 生成的 Lean 代码曾在 OpenAI 高调的 Navier-Stokes 问题证明中弱化原始英文命题的表述；Lean 验证的仅是代码所指向的形式化目标，而非自然语言层面的数学问题本身。 另外还有网上流传的一张疑似 2026 年菲尔兹奖得主邓煜评价此事的聊天截图显示，面对相关提问，其回复称“至少拿出 500 页版本前看都不看”。 即使 Lean 代码通过编译、形式化目标与原始猜想的一致性也得到确认，距离克雷数学研究所的认可仍有漫长距离。 按照该机构规则，千禧年难题的解答必须在同行评审期刊正式发表，并经过至少两年的验证期和数学界普遍接受，才有可能进入奖金评审程序。个人网站声明和代码压缩包不符合提交资格，克雷数学研究所也不接受直接投稿。黎曼猜想于 2000 年被列入七大千禧年难题，奖金为 100 万美元 （现汇率约合 669.2 万元人民币） 。 值得一提的是，Anthropic 于 11 月 19 日刚在纳斯达克挂牌交易，阿尔珀格称他在 11 月 15 日深夜至 16 日凌晨完成关键工作后联系了 Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊，询问公布时机。他承认“时间点非常糟糕”，但表示“实在无法再等下去了”。 今年 8 月，Anthropic 曾公布 Claude 在黎曼猜想相关问题上将关键线上零点比例下界从 41.6% 提高至 67.2% 的成果，当时距离完整证明仍有明显差距。 相关阅读： 《 AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Anthropic 数学家宣称已与 Claude 合作完成证明 》 《 未公开的新模型“立功”，Anthropic 宣布 Claude 攻克黎曼猜想取得重大突破 》 《 继 Claude 尝试攻克黎曼猜想后：OpenAI 宣布用 10000 个 AI 智能体 88 小时攻克千禧年大奖难题，陶哲轩既点赞又担忧 》 《 悬赏百万美元求证明，这道数学题为啥这么值钱？ 》 《 英国“数学教父”阿蒂亚去世，曾宣称证明黎曼猜想 》

items.title_zh: 匿名 AI 模型 Gestalt 登顶 Contra 前沿设计榜单：性能远超 Claude Fable 5.2、GPT-6.1 Sol，Elo 评分超越人类参考作品
items.title_en: Anonymous AI Model Gestalt Tops Contra Frontier Design Benchmark, Beating Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.1 Sol With Elo Above Human Reference Works
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，Contra Labs 于当地时间 11 月 18 日发布 AI 设计能力评测榜单 Frontier Design Benchmark。 其中，一款代号为 Gestalt、目前处于隐身开发状态（Stealth）的匿名 AI 模型成为最大黑马，在专业设计师盲测中以明显优势登顶，超过 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.2、OpenAI 的 GPT-6.1 Sol 等主流模型，甚至在设计师偏好评分中超过了人类设计师的参考作品。 根据 Contra Labs 官方公布的评测结果，Gestalt 的 Elo 评分达到 1931 分，胜率为 90%，位居榜单第一。 排名第二的是人类设计师参考作品 Human golden，Elo 评分为 1739 分，胜率为 74%；Claude Fable 5.2 以 1713 分排名第三，GPT-6.1 Sol 则以 1668 分排名第五。 这项评测由 Contra Labs 与 BenchFlow 合作推出，主要针对真实商业设计任务，而非简单的提示词生成测试。评测任务共 33 项，其中 27 项改编自 Contra 平台上的真实设计委托，另外 6 项来自创业公司合作项目。评测邀请了 35 名专业设计师参与，通过 5 轮盲测累计收集 4311 张投票。 评测采用三项指标：专业设计师双盲偏好投票、设计质量评价体系（Design Critique Rubric），以及 AI 痕迹检测器（Slop Detector）。其中，Elo 评分根据设计师对不同作品的两两比较结果计算，涵盖色彩、字体、布局、可用性以及对任务要求的遵循程度。 在 Gestalt 与人类设计师参考作品的直接对决中，设计师在 28 次比较中有 20 次选择了 Gestalt。不过，这并不意味着 Gestalt 在所有设计质量指标上都全面超越人类作品。 在设计质量评价体系中，Gestalt 得分为 83 分，Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Opus 5.5 均达到 84 分，而人类设计师参考作品为 74 分。Contra Labs 指出，设计师的审美偏好与具体执行质量并不完全相同，人类参考作品虽然存在部分可以明确指出的执行问题，但在盲测中仍获得了较高的偏好票数。 AI 痕迹检测方面，Gestalt 的作品也表现突出，其生成结果的 AI 痕迹评分接近人类参考作品。该检测器通过分类模型判断设计作品呈现出多少 AI 生成作品的典型特征，评分越低意味着作品看起来越不像 AI 生成。 目前 Contra Labs 尚未公开 Gestalt 的开发团队、模型架构及具体身份，仅将其标记为 Stealth。该模型的实际来源和背后团队仍有待进一步确认。 相关阅读： 《 全球最强 AI 模型：Claude Fable 5.2 登场，编程超 GPT-6 Astra、登顶多项基准 》
items.summary_en: Contra Labs released its AI design capability leaderboard, the Frontier Design Benchmark, on November 18 local time. An anonymous AI model codenamed Gestalt, currently in stealth development, was the biggest surprise, topping the blind test of professional designers by a clear margin, ahead of mainstream models such as Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol, and even surpassing human designers' reference works in designer preference scores. According to Contra Labs' published results, Gestalt reached an Elo score of 1931 with a 90% win rate, ranking first. Second was the human designer reference work "Human golden" with an Elo of 1739 and a 74% win rate; Claude Fable 5.2 ranked third at 1713, and GPT-6.1 Sol ranked fifth at 1668. The evaluation, launched by Contra Labs with BenchFlow, targets real commercial design tasks rather than simple prompt-generation tests. There were 33 tasks, 27 adapted from real design commissions on the Contra platform and 6 from startup collaboration projects. 35 professional designers took part, and 5 rounds of blind testing collected 4,311 votes in total. The evaluation uses three metrics: double-blind preference voting by professional designers, a Design Critique Rubric, and a Slop Detector for AI traces. Elo scores are computed from pairwise comparisons by designers, covering color, typography, layout, usability and adherence to task requirements. In head-to-head matchups between Gestalt and the human designer reference works, designers chose Gestalt in 20 of 28 comparisons. However, this does not mean Gestalt comprehensively surpasses human work on all design quality metrics. On the Design Critique Rubric, Gestalt scored 83, with Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5 both at 84, while the human designer reference works scored 74. Contra Labs noted that designers' aesthetic preferences are not the same as execution quality; although the human reference works had some clearly identifiable execution problems, they still received relatively high preference votes in blind tests. On AI-trace detection, Gestalt's work also stood out, with its AI-trace score close to that of human reference works. The detector uses a classification model to judge how many typical characteristics of AI-generated work a design shows; a lower score means the work looks less AI-generated. Contra Labs has not disclosed Gestalt's development team, model architecture or identity, marking it only as stealth. The model's actual origin and backers remain to be confirmed.
items.why_zh: 推测：若榜单方法可信，说明匿名模型可能在真实商业设计任务上接近或超过人类偏好水平，但偏好票与执行质量评分并不一致，且Gestalt来源未明，结论仍属单一榜单结果。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the benchmark methodology holds up, an anonymous model may be approaching or exceeding human preference levels on real commercial design tasks; but preference votes and execution-quality scores diverge, Gestalt's origin is unknown, and the finding rests on a single leaderboard.

items.title_zh: 谷歌搜索首页新增 AI 侧边栏，让你“接着聊”此前提问话题
items.title_en: Google Search Homepage Adds AI Sidebar to Pick Up Earlier AI Conversations
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，谷歌搜索产品副总裁罗比 · 斯坦（Robby Stein）昨日（11 月 20 日）在 X 平台发布推文，宣布 Google Search 首页将迎来新一轮调整， 面向全球桌面端逐步推出可折叠侧边栏，让用户直接从首页查找和继续此前的 AI 搜索对话。 根据演示，用户点击页面左侧的灰色条，即可展开侧边栏，查看通过“AI 模式”（AI Mode）进行的搜索记录。面板还提供新建对话、搜索历史对话以及连接 Gemini 笔记本等入口。选择已有记录后，用户可以回到相应话题继续提问，不必重新从头搜索。 斯坦指出本次改进的重点是让搜索具备更强的连续性，根据内部调查数据显示，用户在搜索页面带来了越来越多无法通过一次查询解决的问题，而侧边栏有助于他们继续推进任务、深入探索网络信息。 推进部署方面，AI 入口前置并不意味着传统搜索被取代。据报道，输入关键词后直接按回车，仍会显示常规搜索结果；用户需主动选择 AI 模式，才会进入相应体验。目前更新正分批上线，不同用户看到的新界面可能存在时间差。 IT之家目前尝试访问谷歌搜索页面，暂未发现相关 AI 侧边栏，“AI 模式”按钮存在于搜索框内。
items.summary_en: Google Search vice president of product Robby Stein posted on X on November 20 announcing a new round of changes to the Google Search homepage: a collapsible sidebar rolling out gradually worldwide on desktop, letting users find and continue earlier AI search conversations directly from the homepage. In the demo, clicking a gray bar on the left of the page expands the sidebar to show search history conducted through "AI Mode." The panel also offers entry points for starting a new conversation, searching past conversations and connecting Gemini notebooks. After selecting an existing thread, users can return to the topic and keep asking questions without starting over. Stein said the focus is greater continuity in search; according to internal survey data, users increasingly bring questions to the search page that cannot be resolved with a single query, and the sidebar helps them keep working on tasks and explore web information further. On rollout, moving the AI entry point forward does not mean traditional search is replaced. According to the report, typing keywords and pressing enter still shows conventional search results; users must actively choose AI Mode to enter that experience. The update is rolling out in batches, so different users may see the new interface at different times. When IT之家 tried accessing Google Search, the AI sidebar was not yet visible; the "AI Mode" button appears inside the search box.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该改版推进，搜索首页的入口结构将从“一次性查询”转向可延续的AI会话，可能改变用户与搜索的交互习惯及AI功能的分发方式。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the redesign spreads, the search homepage's entry structure may shift from one-off queries toward resumable AI sessions, potentially changing user interaction habits and how AI features are distributed.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于昨日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。华为星芒品牌总经理刘赫开通微博， 透露最受欢迎的 16G 版本已经在全平台售罄 。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 IT之家注意到，刘赫还在自己微博的评论区与网友展开了互动，并解答了不少消费者的疑惑。针对大家最关心的星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 首发新功能华为 Mate 系列能否 OTA 支持相关问题，刘赫的回复如下： 能不能反馈一下 Mate 也做一套新图标？ 那我就... 不反馈给他们了 [狗头斜眼] 开玩笑的， 但是我的 AI 屏和星芒⭐他们是没有滴 星芒默认图标啥时候上放给 Mate 系列？ 不给 [狗头斜眼] 这意味着，华为星芒的开山之作 —— OSTA O1 Pro 的全新设计图标、AI 屏和小星芒为独占特性。而新图标有望后续开放给其他系列机型使用，但 AI 屏和小星芒暂时未有相关计划。 参考IT之家此前报道，华为 Mate 90 系列手机和华为 Pura X View 已推送鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 版本升级，带来了 AI 快捷栏。 但 Mate 90 系列和 Pura X View 的 AI 快捷栏与星芒手机的功能有所差异，且在外观设计思路上也截然不同 。 相关阅读： 《 华为星芒刘赫：OSTA O1 Pro 最受欢迎的 16G 版本已在全平台售罄，远超预期 》 《 5499 元起，“首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机”华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 阔直板正式发布 》 《 华为 Pura X View 阔直板手机获 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 升级，桌面 AI 快捷栏如约而至 》 《 华为 Mate 90 系列手机 AI 快捷栏全新交互体验曝光，与星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 风格完全不同 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 21 that Huawei's Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro, billed as the first HarmonyOS phone built for AI, was officially launched the previous afternoon, starting at 4,999 yuan after national subsidies. Liu He, general manager of the Huawei Xingmang brand, opened a Weibo account and said the most popular 16G version has sold out across all platforms. In comments on Weibo, asked whether the Mate series could get the OSTA O1 Pro's debut features via OTA, Liu replied that Mate users "don't have my AI screen and Xingmang"; asked when Xingmang's default icons would come to the Mate series, he replied "not giving them." IT之家 concludes that the OSTA O1 Pro's newly designed icons, AI screen and "little star" feature are exclusive; the new icons may later be opened to other series, but there are no plans yet for the AI screen and little star. Earlier reports said the Huawei Mate 90 series and Huawei Pura X View have received HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115, bringing an AI quick bar, though its functions and design differ from the Xingmang phone.
items.why_zh: （推测）这说明华为在子品牌首发功能上采取差异化策略，可能影响 Mate 系列用户的升级预期与产品定位讨论。
items.why_en: (Speculation) This suggests Huawei is differentiating features for its sub-brand, which may affect Mate users' upgrade expectations and discussion of product positioning.

items.title_zh: Take-Two 前 CEO 费德：《GTA 6》将是 AI 时代前夜最后的“传统”3A 大作
items.title_en: Former Take-Two CEO Feder: GTA 6 may be the last 'traditional' AAA game before the AI era
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，Take-Two 前 CEO 本 · 费德认为，《GTA 6》将成为 AI 时代全面到来前 最后一部采用传统开发模式打造的 3A 大作 ，游戏行业也将由此告别一个时代。 费德在《财富》杂志撰文称：“《GTA 6》的发布将成为一场文化盛事，带来史诗般的游戏体验。我相信它会是一部杰作，但也会是同类作品中的最后一部。” IT之家获悉，他认为，原因并非 R 星的质量把控能力下降，也不是 AI 能让游戏开发更快、更省钱，而是《GTA 6》代表着一种即将 被 AI 颠覆的创作模式的巅峰 。 费德指出，游戏开发过程中，改变方向甚至放弃原有创意，都可能耗费大量时间和技术资源，AI 可以大幅降低改变主意的成本。 费德将 AI 对游戏行业的影响，比作摄影术对绘画的冲击：“摄影术问世时，许多视觉艺术家担心生计受到威胁，其中一些人的担忧确实成真了：委托画家绘制肖像的市场崩溃了。但也有人开始思考另一个问题：接下来我们还能创作什么？摆脱了忠实还原现实的要求后，他们开创了全新甚至颠覆性的艺术形式，包括印象派、立体主义和抽象艺术。我猜想，未来的文化史学家看待《GTA 6》， 就像艺术史学家看待最后一批伟大的写实主义画家一样 。” 在他看来，《GTA 6》是一种创作模式在媒介边界被打破、全新艺术形式涌现之前所达到的最高成就。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that former Take-Two CEO Ben Feder believes GTA 6 will be the last AAA game built with traditional development methods before the AI era fully arrives, closing a chapter for the games industry. Writing in Fortune, Feder said: "The launch of GTA 6 will be a cultural event, delivering an epic experience. I believe it will be a masterpiece, but also the last of its kind." He argued the reason is neither a decline in Rockstar's quality control nor AI making games faster and cheaper, but that GTA 6 represents the pinnacle of a creative model about to be disrupted by AI. Feder noted that changing direction or abandoning ideas during development can consume large amounts of time and technical resources, and AI can sharply lower the cost of changing one's mind. He compared AI's impact on games to photography's impact on painting, saying that when photography arrived many visual artists feared for their livelihoods and some of those fears came true as the commissioned-portrait market collapsed, but others asked what else they could create and, freed from the demand for faithful representation, pioneered impressionism, cubism and abstract art. He speculated that future cultural historians will view GTA 6 as art historians view the last great realist painters. In his view, GTA 6 is the highest achievement of a creative model just before media boundaries break and new art forms emerge.
items.why_zh: （推测）这是业内人士的个人观点，提示 AI 可能改变 3A 游戏的开发流程与创作方式，但并非对行业的确定预测。
items.why_en: (Speculation) This is one industry veteran's personal view, suggesting AI may change AAA development pipelines and creative methods rather than offering a definitive industry forecast.

items.title_zh: 玩家在《极限竞速：地平线 6》中偶遇已故好友 Drivatar AI 车手，得以再次“并肩驾车”重温昨日时光
items.title_en: Player meets late friend's Drivatar AI driver in Forza Horizon 6
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，《极限竞速：地平线 6（Forza Horizon 6）》玩家 Samohteht 近日分享了一段令人动容的游戏经历。他在游戏中意外遇见了 4 个月前离世的好友留在游戏里的 Drivatar AI 车手，两人得以再次并肩驾车巡航，这段视频在社交平台引发广泛关注，也让不少玩家想起了自己曾通过游戏与故人重逢的经历。 参考 Samohteht 在 Instagram 发布的视频。画面中，他驾车时遇见了好友 Mabel1411 留在游戏里的 Drivatar。随后，两辆车并排行驶，仿佛两人从未天人永隔。 Samohteht 表示：“我最好的朋友在 4 个月前离开了。每隔一段时间，我就会在《极限竞速：地平线 6》里遇见他的 Drivatar。有那么一小段时间，我们又能一起兜风了，不需要言语，没有告别，也没有悲伤，就只是两个朋友并肩开着车，一切（事故）仿佛从未发生过。” Samohteht 形容，这短暂的片刻让世界再次恢复了正常。“我知道这只是一款游戏，但有时候，这已经是我最接近再次见到他的方式了。”最后，他还向好友送上生日祝福：“生日快乐。我很想你，兄弟。” 这段视频在 Instagram 上累计获得超过 177.7 万个赞。Samohteht 随后也向留言的网友表达感谢，称自己收到了太多暖心回应，已经无法逐一回复：“谢谢大家留下这些温暖的话。我们一起纪念了他，他一定会感到骄傲。” 公开信息显示， 《极限竞速》系列中的 Drivatar 是一套能够学习真实玩家驾驶风格的系统。游戏会分析玩家的驾驶习惯，并据此建立相应的 AI 驾驶数据 ，之后该玩家的 Drivatar 便会随机出现在其他人的游戏中。 Drivatar 最早于 2005 年的《极限竞速》（Forza Motorsport）中登场，并在 2013 年推出的《极限竞速 5》（Forza Motorsport 5）中加入在线分享功能。由于这套系统能够保留玩家的驾驶特征，因此即使原玩家已经离世，其 Drivatar 仍可能继续出现在其他玩家的游戏世界里。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that Forza Horizon 6 player Samohteht shared an experience in which he unexpectedly encountered the Drivatar AI driver left in the game by a friend who died four months earlier, allowing the two to drive side by side once more; the video drew wide attention on social media. In the video posted on Instagram, Samohteht encounters the Drivatar left by his friend Mabel1411, and the two cars then drive side by side. Samohteht said: "My best friend left four months ago. Every so often I run into his Drivatar in Forza Horizon 6. For a brief moment we get to cruise together again — no words needed, no goodbye, no sadness, just two friends driving side by side." He said the brief moment made the world feel normal again: "I know it's just a game, but sometimes this is the closest I can get to seeing him again." He also wished his friend a happy birthday: "Happy birthday. I miss you, brother." The video has received more than 1.777 million likes on Instagram, and he thanked commenters for their warm words, saying "we remembered him together, and he would be proud." Public information shows that Drivatar in the Forza series learns real players' driving styles: the game analyzes a player's driving habits and builds corresponding AI driving data, after which that player's Drivatar may randomly appear in other players' games. Drivatar debuted in 2005's Forza Motorsport, and online sharing was added in 2013's Forza Motorsport 5. Because the system preserves a player's driving traits, a Drivatar may keep appearing in others' games even after the original player has died.
items.why_zh: （推测）这一事件反映出基于玩家行为数据训练的 AI 角色会在玩家离世后继续留存，可能引发关于数据留存与情感伦理的讨论。
items.why_en: (Speculation) The episode illustrates how AI characters trained on player behavior can persist after a player's death, which may prompt discussion of data retention and emotional ethics.

items.title_en: Former Nvidia AI software product director recalls Jensen Huang: tough in style, warm at heart
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《商业内幕》，现年 43 岁、曾与黄仁勋共事三年半的前英伟达 AI 应用软件产品管理总监贾马尔，讲述了自己近距离观察黄仁勋及与其共事的经历。 IT之家附上全文大意如下： 在英伟达，黄仁勋与员工保持密切接触 我 2022 年加入英伟达，一直工作到 2025 年下半年，担任 AI 应用软件产品管理总监，办公室位于总部的 Endeavor 大楼，与黄仁勋办公室共处一地。 入职第一天，我穿过公司主楼时，突然看见黄仁勋独自从走廊里走出来。我忍不住上前向他问好。他马上停下脚步，热情地回应了我，我们当场 聊了三四十秒 。 此前我在博通工作了四年，却从未有过这样偶遇 CEO 的经历。黄仁勋表现出的 亲和力和谦逊 让我印象深刻，那是一次很好的初次接触。 只要他没有出差，我基本每隔三四天就能在办公室走廊里见到他一次。他是否出差也很容易判断：如果他不在办公室，门外等着与他见面的人就不会那么多。 根据工作内容的不同，我每隔四到六周会参加一次与黄仁勋面对面的集体会议。我从未见过他单独与员工进行一对一会谈。他更倾向于让七人、十人甚至更多人一起开会，确保所有人在同一时间获得完全一致的信息。 “Top 5 Things” 邮件让公司信息保持透明 英伟达有一条不成文的规定：参加黄仁勋的会议之前，最好先把自己的“Top 5 Things”（T5T）邮件发出去。 T5T 是一种简单直接的工作汇报机制。每位员工每周或每月都要向黄仁勋及其管理团队发送邮件，列出自己负责的五项重点工作、目前遇到的障碍，以及需要哪些帮助。 黄仁勋不会依靠传统管理层级层层过滤信息，而是通过阅读数千封 T5T 邮件，直接、实时地了解公司的实际情况。无论你是初级工程师还是高级总监，都有机会让自己的声音和技术见解直达最高管理层。这也让整个组织保持信息透明，确保所有人目标一致、步调协调。 我经常看到黄仁勋亲自回复员工的 T5T 邮件。当然，并不是每封邮件都会得到回复，但员工都会发送邮件，并将他抄送在内。 我记得有一次会议上，有人提出一个问题，黄仁勋随即暂停会议，问道：“你在‘Top 5 Things’邮件里写过这个问题吗？”在场的人立刻纷纷低头查看自己的笔记本电脑。 这让我意识到，T5T 绝不是走形式的工作汇报。黄仁勋希望员工主动汇报手头的工作和遇到的问题，让能够解决问题的人参与进来。 通过 T5T，公司实现了自下而上的信息互通。 黄仁勋亲自把关每一个细节 筹备 GTC（英伟达旗舰 AI 大会）时，最能体现黄仁勋对工作的投入，以及他对自己所擅长领域的热爱。我们会专门开会，确定哪些演示项目能够在 GTC 上展示。 黄仁勋和团队对演示效果近乎苛求，力求每个环节都做到完美。他不满足于只看幻灯片，还会亲自走遍演示区，逐一检查每个展台，不断追问：“为什么要这样设计？这个东西具体在做什么？” 我记得有一次，他在一个演示展台前停留了将近 30 分钟，亲自给团队提出具体改进意见，指导他们如何进一步提升演示效果。团队按照他的建议修改后，再次展示时效果明显更好。 没有任何演示项目能够绕过他的技术标准。只有达到他个人对技术完美的要求，才有资格登上舞台。 我从黄仁勋身上学到的重要经验之一，是尽可能减少管理层与一线实际情况之间的信息隔阂。他能够直接与工程师和产品开发人员交流，不让中层管理者过滤、扭曲实际情况。看到他如此有效地做到这一点，我也学会了贴近产品本身的问题，以及客户在使用过程中遇到的实际障碍。 他也有温暖的一面 除了工作中表现出的强烈投入，黄仁勋还有鲜为外界所知的温暖和人情味，而这一面很少出现在新闻报道中。 2024 年初，我女儿出生后，给黄仁勋发了一封简短邮件报喜。我本以为他工作繁忙，未必有时间留意，没想到他在五分钟内就回复了我，向我表示祝贺。 几天后，也可能是一周后，我正在开会，他的行政助理突然走进会议室，当着所有人的面叫了我的名字。随后，她带我来到黄仁勋的办公室。那里有一个他特意为我刚出生的女儿准备的精美礼盒。 我和妻子打开礼盒，发现里面有一张黄仁勋留下的卡片，上面写着：“谢赫拉姆，恭喜你喜得千金。祝妈妈和宝宝一切安好。” 我想，那张卡片确实是他亲笔写的，也有他的签名。礼盒里还有印有英伟达标志、送给女儿的衣服和袜子。 我从没听过有人抱怨黄仁勋 过去一周，关于黄仁勋的新闻很多。但如果只…
items.summary_en: According to Business Insider, Jamal, 43, a former Nvidia director of AI application software product management who worked with Jensen Huang for three and a half years, described his close-up observations of and experience working with Huang. He joined Nvidia in 2022 and stayed until the second half of 2025, with an office in the headquarters' Endeavor building, on the same floor as Huang's office. On his first day he ran into Huang in a hallway and spoke with him for 30 to 40 seconds — something that never happened during four years at Broadcom. When Huang was not traveling, he would see him in the hallway roughly every three or four days; every four to six weeks he attended a group meeting with Huang in person, and he never saw Huang hold one-on-one meetings with employees — Huang preferred meetings of seven, ten or more people so everyone received exactly the same information at the same time. Nvidia has an unwritten rule: before attending a Huang meeting, you had better send your "Top 5 Things" (T5T) email — each employee lists five priorities, current obstacles and needed help to Huang and his management team weekly or monthly. Rather than relying on management layers to filter information, Huang reads thousands of T5T emails to understand the company directly and in real time; Jamal often saw Huang personally reply to employees' T5T emails. At one meeting, when someone raised a question, Huang paused and asked: "Did you write this in your 'Top 5 Things' email?" When preparing for GTC, Huang would walk the demo area and inspect each booth, asking why it was designed that way and what it actually did; he once spent nearly 30 minutes at one booth giving specific improvement suggestions, and the demo was noticeably better after the team made the changes. Jamal said one key lesson was to minimize the information gap between management and the front line. He also described Huang's warmer side: after his daughter was born in early 2024, he sent a short congratulatory email and Huang replied within five minutes; days later Huang's executive assistant pulled him out of a meeting and took him to Huang's office, where there was a gift box for the newborn containing a card reading "Congratulations Shehram on your new baby girl. Best wishes to mom and baby" (which he believes Huang wrote and signed himself) plus Nvidia-logo baby clothes and socks. He also said he never heard anyone complain about Huang.
items.why_zh: 推测：这类一线员工回忆为外界观察英伟达的管理方式与黄仁勋个人风格提供了细节，可能影响人们对该公司组织效率与文化的判断。
items.why_en: Speculation: such first-hand employee recollections offer detail on Nvidia's management style and Huang's personal style, which may shape perceptions of the company's organizational efficiency and culture.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 新一轮千亿级融资落地，梁文锋保留绝对控制权
items.title_en: Report: DeepSeek closes hundred-billion-yuan round, Liang Wenfeng retains control with about 67.42% stake
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，工商信息显示，DeepSeek 运营主体杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司近日完成工商变更，新增股东杭州程砚企业管理咨询合伙企业（有限合伙）。 IT之家查询国家企业信用信息公示系统获悉，杭州深度求索注册资本由 1644.7496 万元增至 1991.8707 万元，增加 347.1211 万元，增幅约 21.1%。 据证券时报援引知情交易人士消息， DeepSeek 本轮融资募资规模区间在 1000 亿元至 1055 亿元 ，投后估值约 6155 亿元。叠加 2026 年 6 月首轮约 510 亿元融资，市场测算其短时间内两轮累计吸纳资金将超 1500 亿元。 据测算， 梁文锋直接及间接持股比例合计约 67.42% ，千亿资本入场并未改变控制权归属 。 作为新增股东的持股平台，杭州程砚也同步完成工商变更，登记出资额增至 343897.9 万元， 同时新增 31 家合伙人 。目前，杭州程砚合计拥有 32 名合伙人，杭州程策商务咨询有限公司仍担任执行事务合伙人。 据悉，杭州程砚的 31 家合伙人横跨互联网、通信运营商、芯片半导体、新能源、消费电子、汽车、家电以及头部 PE / VC，几乎把大模型商业化所需的上游算力与下游场景一次性集齐。 出资比例排在最前面的，是腾讯与宁德时代体系。腾讯旗下上海珩岫商业管理有限公司出资比例 9.5653%，为第一大出资人；宁德时代通过厦门时代怡远（4.9198%）、厦门时代深远（4.4410%）、福建时代泽远（0.2045%）三只基金合计出资同样为 9.5653%，与腾讯并列居前。 紧随其后的是中移投资控股与中信证券投资，各出资 7.6522%；砺思资本相关主体出资 7.1740%，进入前五。 除此之外，合伙人还囊括了中国移动、中国电信、美团龙珠、网易雷火、小红书、携程系、vivo、美的、立讯体系（立臻精密）、吉利产投、兆易创新、中芯聚源、横店资本等；投资机构一端则聚集了博裕、IDG、高榕、君联、正心谷、CPE 源峰、拾象、石溪资本、国寿股权、中金系等。 工商信息显示，杭州程砚的执行事务合伙人仍由杭州程策商务咨询有限公司担任，而梁文锋持有杭州程策 99% 股权。也就是说， 31 家外部股东进入的是持股平台，通过平台间接享有经济收益 ，杭州程策作为普通合伙人控制权牢牢留在创始人一侧。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that business registration records show DeepSeek's operating entity, Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., recently completed a registration change adding Hangzhou Chengyan Enterprise Management Consulting Partnership (LP) as a shareholder. According to the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, registered capital rose from 16.447496 million yuan to 19.918707 million yuan, an increase of 3.471211 million yuan, or about 21.1%. Citing informed traders, Securities Times reported that DeepSeek's new round raised between 100 billion and 105.5 billion yuan at a post-money valuation of about 615.5 billion yuan; combined with a first round of about 51 billion yuan in June 2026, market estimates put the two rounds at over 150 billion yuan in total. Estimates put Liang Wenfeng's direct and indirect stake at about 67.42%, with the large capital inflow not changing control. Hangzhou Chengyan, the new shareholder platform, raised its registered contribution to 3.438979 billion yuan and added 31 partners for a total of 32, with Hangzhou Chengce Business Consulting Co., Ltd. remaining as general partner. The report says the 31 partners span internet, telecom carriers, chips/semiconductors, new energy, consumer electronics, autos, home appliances and leading PE/VC firms. Tencent and CATL's entities lead by contribution: Shanghai Hengxiu Commercial Management Co., Ltd. (Tencent) at 9.5653%, the largest contributor, and CATL through three funds also totaling 9.5653%. They are followed by China Mobile Investment Holdings and CITIC Securities Investment at 7.6522% each, and a Lishi Capital-related entity at 7.1740%. Partners also include China Mobile, China Telecom, Meituan Dragon Ball, NetEase Leihuo, Xiaohongshu, Ctrip-affiliated entities, vivo, Midea, the Luxshare system (Lizhen Precision), Geely Industrial Investment, GigaDevice, SMIC Capital, Hengdian Capital, as well as Boyu, IDG, Gaorong, Legend Capital, Zhengxin Valley, CPE, Shixiang, Shixi Capital, China Life Equity and CICC-affiliated institutions. Registration records show the general partner remains Hangzhou Chengce Business Consulting Co., Ltd., 99% owned by Liang Wenfeng, meaning the 31 external shareholders hold indirect economic interests through the platform.
items.why_zh: （推测）若融资金额属实，创始人保留控制权且合伙人覆盖算力与场景上下游，可能影响国内大模型竞争格局；融资数据来自知情人士消息与市场测算，尚未见公司确认。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，工商信息显示，DeepSeek 运营主体杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司近日完成工商变更，新增股东杭州程砚企业管理咨询合伙企业（有限合伙）。 IT之家查询国家企业信用信息公示系统获悉，杭州深度求索注册资本由 1644.7496 万元增至 1991.8707 万元，增加 347.1211 万元，增幅约 21.1%。 据证券时报援引知情交易人士消息， DeepSeek 本轮融资募资规模区间在 1000 亿元至 1055 亿元 ，投后估值约 6155 亿元。叠加 2026 年 6 月首轮约 510 亿元融资，市场测算其短时间内两轮累计吸纳资金将超 1500 亿元。 据测算， 梁文锋直接及间接持股比例合计约 67.42% ，千亿资本入场并未改变控制权归属 。 作为新增股东的持股平台，杭州程砚也同步完成工商变更，登记出资额增至 343897.9 万元， 同时新增 31 家合伙人 。目前，杭州程砚合计拥有 32 名合伙人，杭州程策商务咨询有限公司仍担任执行事务合伙人。 据悉，杭州程砚的 31 家合伙人横跨互联网、通信运营商、芯片半导体、新能源、消费电子、汽车、家电以及头部 PE / VC，几乎把大模型商业化所需的上游算力与下游场景一次性集齐。 出资比例排在最前面的，是腾讯与宁德时代体系。腾讯旗下上海珩岫商业管理有限公司出资比例 9.5653%，为第一大出资人；宁德时代通过厦门时代怡远（4.9198%）、厦门时代深远（4.4410%）、福建时代泽远（0.2045%）三只基金合计出资同样为 9.5653%，与腾讯并列居前。 紧随其后的是中移投资控股与中信证券投资，各出资 7.6522%；砺思资本相关主体出资 7.1740%，进入前五。 除此之外，合伙人还囊括了中国移动、中国电信、美团龙珠、网易雷火、小红书、携程系、vivo、美的、立讯体系（立臻精密）、吉利产投、兆易创新、中芯聚源、横店资本等；投资机构一端则聚集了博裕、IDG、高榕、君联、正心谷、CPE 源峰、拾象、石溪资本、国寿股权、中金系等。 工商信息显示，杭州程砚的执行事务合伙人仍由杭州程策商务咨询有限公司担任，而梁文锋持有杭州程策 99% 股权。也就是说， 31 家外部股东进入的是持股平台，通过平台间接享有经济收益 ，杭州程策作为普通合伙人控制权牢牢留在创始人一侧。

items.summary_en: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans. Each task’s difficulty was scored by how long it took the human testers to finish it—and then models were rated according to the length of the tasks that they could complete. That plot showed that AI systems were rapidly improving—every four months, the length of the tasks that frontier models could successfully complete doubled. The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended. items.summary_zh: Google 表示，其 macOS 版 Gemini 应用现已具备“computer use”（操控电脑）能力，可帮助用户“在本地文件、桌面应用和网页之间完成多步骤任务”。Google 称，该功能可能适用于加速工作流程、填写表单、制作演示文稿和发布商品出售信息等场景。Google 表示，用户可以决定 Gemini 能访问哪些应用，并且可以借助 Gemini 自带的背景窗口在对话中查看实时预览，从而跟随其操作过程。该功能目前正在面向美国用户以英文推出。完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web," the company says . Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale. Users will be able to decide which of your apps Gemini can access, and be able to follow along as Gemini works because it has its own background window that shows a live preview in your chat, Google says. items.summary_zh: 2026年11月18日，交易员在纽约证券交易所早盘交易时段工作。图片来源：Getty Images。英伟达临时CEO Colette Kress在周二晚结束这家陷入困境的芯片公司第三季度财报电话会议时表示：“我们能搞定。”到周四，公司股价徘徊在每股约150美元，较10月6日的历史高点下跌近40%，抹去了周二晚财报发布后的短暂上涨。与此同时，华尔街正为英伟达最大客户之一支付溢价：Anthropic以每股111.50美元在纳斯达克上市，比预期高出34%。仅看财报数字，英伟达本季度表现亮眼。第三季度营收较去年同期增长一倍多……完整报道见 The Verge。

By Thursday, the company's stock price was hovering at around $150 per share, a nearly 40 percent drop from its all-time high on October 6th, and wiping out a brief post-earnings pop on Tuesday night. Meanwhile, Wall Street was paying up for one of Nvidia's biggest customers as Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut at $111.50 per share - 34 percent higher than expected.
